notes_for_editor: The 1938 build date, the 100 ft height (entered as 30.5 m) and the 7 ft cab come from one peakbagging photo page; no second source was found, so the date is single-sourced. The removal date is in no source read. The 2015 trip report's foundation sentence says 'the peak' without naming it; I read it as Mica Mountain because the report's heading is Mica Mountain and the writer goes on to Spud Rock, but that link is an inference. The 1946 datasheet is tied to the summit by the peakbagging page alone. Staffing and fire history: no source found, left out. A HikeArizona page that mentions concrete footings returned HTTP 403 and was not cited. Public access rests on the park boundary and the 2015 hike; no current closure check was made. Idaho's Mica Peak lookout is a different structure and should not be merged with this record. The Happy Valley lookout in the same park is separate and is described only to prevent confusion.
